newsitem.title: USA: Prodigy sets new flat rate monthly service fees.
newsitem.headline: Prodigy sets new flat rate monthly service fees.

text.p: Prodigy Services Corp said Wednesday it set new flat-rate pricing structures for its Prodigy Classic and Prodigy Internet services, bringing the service in line with the pricing of its major competitors.
Prodiogy Classic will be available at a flat fee of $19.95 a month for unlimited usage, matching its existing fee for unlimited usage of its Prodigy Internet service, which was launched in October.
Customers who select the company's Prodigy Internet product will be able to use both Prodigy Internet and Prodigy Classic for one fee of $19.95 a month for unlimited usage.
Subscribers to the Prodigy Classic plan who choose the Prodigy Internet $19.95 Unlimited Plan will be allowed unlimited use of Prodigy Classic, the company said.
Prodigy Classic will still be available at the monthly fee of $9.95, which limits users to five free hours usage, after which the service is billed at $2.95 an hour.
Prodigy said that it also would begin implementing reduced-rate Prodigy Internet pricing for prepaid terms, effective January 30, 1997.
Under those plans, a two-year prepaid term would lower the monthly rate to $14.95, and a one-year prepaid term would lower the monthly rate to $17.95.
